findings.text: The documented `simp only [step_rule, found]` reports “`simp` made no progress” on the CREATE TABLE rule’s own equation. Fix: use `simp (disch := assumption) only [step_rule]`, which closes that goal with the resolution equation in scope.

The fixture applies `runScriptStep_createTable_eq` by name, so removing its `@[step_rule]` registration leaves the tests green. Fix: rewrite this fixture through `step_rule` with `assumption` as the discharger.

The model docstring describes `sql_run` as reading this set, although the surface tactic still selects CREATE TABLE through a fixed branch in `sendRule`. Fix: describe the attribute’s meaning in the model and document tactic dispatch in the surface when it uses the set.

The status says `just test-full` runs both failed tests, but `test_installed_core_and_codec_consumer` has the `requires_nix` marker and runs under `just test-nix`. Fix: assign the README example to `just test-full` and the installed consumer test to `just test-nix`.

The current sources list directs readers to `CreateTableStepLaws.lean`, which this commit deletes. Fix: list `CreateTableRule.lean` as the current source and keep the deleted path in the progress log.
The progress log describes `Sql.check_send_createTable` as already removed in a later commit, although this revision still defines and calls it. Fix: describe its removal as planned.
This third core import of `Lean.Meta.Tactic.Simp.RegisterCommand` leaves ADR 0006’s inventory at two importers. Fix: update the inventory to include `StepRuleAttr.lean` and `step_rule`.

The new module documents the attribute but has no module docstring, and its Verso markup is unchecked. Fix: enable `doc.verso` and add a module docstring explaining why registration lives in a separate import.
The new module documents its theorem but has no module docstring. Fix: add a short module docstring explaining that clients can derive CREATE TABLE step facts from one exact equation.
